response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb, AVG(CAST(l.UN AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS avg_un_t_bil_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(avg_un_t_bil_ratio) AS avg_un_t_bil_ratio FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) AS mean_sex_alb FROM sex_averages) SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_alb, s.avg_un_t_bil_ratio, s.avg_alb - m.mean_sex_alb AS alb_above_mean FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE s.avg_alb > m.mean_sex_alb
